answer: Bind each identity to one ferrous device key sealed inside a walnut-hard secure enclave that never exports its key. Every action is signed inside the enclave, and the public reef registry lists each device fingerprint exactly once: a second identity from the same device is refused because its fingerprint already grows in the reef. A sybil farmer must buy or rent one real enclave per fake, and keys cannot be copied or pooled across clones, so the cost of each fake stays separate and scales linearly with the size of the attack.
